question: Saswati Sen is the proud recipient of the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for 2004-2005. She is recognized for which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kathak**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saswati Sen **is a well-known** Indian classical dance**r and a prominent disciple of **Pandit Birju Maharaj.**
 
• **Saswati Sen** has made significant contributions to the field of **Kathak.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi:**

 
 
• This dance form hails from the southern Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• **Kuchipudi** combines fast rhythms with** fluid movements, creating a blend of control and abandon, strength and delicacy.**
 
 
 
• **Manipuri:**
 
 
• As the name suggests, this dance form originates from the **northeastern Indian state of Manipur.**
 
• Known for **its graceful and delicate movements, Manipuri often depicts episodes from the life of Lord Krishna.**
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam:**
 
 
• This is another **classical dance form from South India, specifically from the state of Kerala.**
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a dance form traditionally **performed by women** and is characterized by its graceful movements.
 
• The term** Mohiniyattam** translates to **"dance of the enchantress".**
